name: personal-long-job-supervisor
description: Run long local commands in detached process sessions and resume Codex only for durable events.

interface.longDescription: Launch long local commands in detached process sessions, verify PID identity through Linux procfs, keep logs outside model context, and wait for bounded completed, failed, or heartbeat-attention events.
interface.defaultPrompt: Supervise this authorized long command without model polling, then continue only when an event arrives.
